name: fred-timeseries
description: FRED® economic data plus statistically honest time-series tools (STL, ADF/KPSS, ARCH-LM, ARIMA, AR-GARCH-t, rolling backtests) and a skill that tells the agent when each method is warranted. This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

fred_api_key.title: FRED API key
fred_api_key.description: Free key from https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/apikeys (32 lowercase letters/digits). Required for search, metadata and data.
